920.synopsis:

The 38th generation of the Twelve Holy Knights have completed their term of office, yet the time for the 39th generation to take over is still far in the indefinite future.

What must he do in order to become comrades, who will fight through thick and thin for each other, with this group of “younger brothers”?

And that wasn’t the only problem.
While I was taking care of this child—without even knowing which family he came from—someone showed up at my door.
The man softened his sharp gaze and said:
“I’m Karlos Enduke.”
I knew instantly.
He was the future husband from the original story. And to make matters worse—
“So… you’re saying I had a child with the baron?”
Even the truths I wasn’t supposed to know were being revealed.

136088.synopsis:
[The Player’s body perfectly meets the requirements of Love Castle. Sensitivity, endurance, and le*dness are all at an exceptional level.
Now, the Player must complete the missions presented by the virtual world’s status window, and through this, obtain rewards.] 
Woosol, with a hermaphroditic body, a strong libido, and a submissive nature, lived burdened with desires he could never satisfy in reality—until a system appeared and drew him into a game world.
In this virtual realm, he is relentlessly trained to experience forbidden pleasures.
And there, he encounters an S who looks uncannily like his first love, Jaehyuk.

138904.synopsis:
Lin Xuan, who has zero motivation to work, accidentally binds with a gourmet food system.
Each week, he’s sent to a random location with a random food mission.
But his very first task leaves him dumbfounded.
What? Sell extra-spicy grilled wings at the entrance of a proctology hospital?
What kind of hellish mission is this?!
And that’s just the beginning.
Garlic pork at a singles mixer, fried chicken at a gym, stinky tofu at a concert, marathon-only food orders, fried rice at a pricey buffet, selling baozi from a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, reciting domineering CEO lines in public…
Turns out, as long as the food tastes amazing, customers’ standards keep dropping.
They love and hate Boss Lin in equal measure.
Customer 1: My hemorrhoids are cured—why did Boss Lin move again?
Customer 2: Boss Lin, can you act like a normal human being for once?!
Customer 3: I don’t even care where he sets up anymore. As long as he’s open for business, I’m the happiest person alive.
associated_names: 我的美食随机刷新，顾客馋哭了

162712.synopsis:
Her former lover from two years ago sent her a proposal.
She couldn’t understand his intentions, but because she still loved him, Elaria accepted the proposal.
Their bodies became closer than when they had been lovers, yet strangely, their hearts did not.
“Why… did you propose to me?”
“Then why did you accept?”
The more time she spent with him, the less she felt she understood him.
“You let me ravage you thoroughly yesterday, so why are you acting shy now.”
“Ah, don’t say things like that…”
“Why, because your Lucian doesn’t use such crude words?”
At times, it even felt as if there was another person within him.
And yet…
I really didn’t know.
I thought I loved one man. There were two.
associated_names: Bound By Two Rings: I Didn’t Know I Had Two Husbands

168344.synopsis:
My tr*sh ex-husband who cheated throughout the marriage and even accused me of being the cheater has returned.
“Why did we divorce?”
“…What?”
“I can’t even believe I married you, why did we divorce, Hongdan?”
And he’s done so with only the memories of his high school days remaining.
“I don’t remember anything.”
Who could have imagined?
That the human who treated me like a rag and eventually made me lose my first child would appear again and cling to me as if nothing had happened.
“Hongdan! My pretty wife! I’m home!”
Damn it.
I’ve had enough of being a pushover during the three years of marriage.
Now, there will be no compromise with Yeon Seonha.
“If you help me find my memories for three months, I’ll give you half my fortune.”
So clearly, there’s no compromise, and yet…
“Let’s get along.”
Cohabitation with my tr*sh ex-husband began after one year.
He’s offering 50 billion won.
If it doesn’t work out, I’ll just throw him away later.
“Let’s stick together for just three months.”
associated_names: Please Practice Proper Waste Separation and Disposal

175768.synopsis:
The character kuo means “to expand,” but it also carries the sense of a thorough cleansing.
Cast into the tumultuous era of the Eastern Jin (317–420 CE) and the Sixteen Kingdoms (304–439 CE), any transmigrator would naturally dream of stirring the waters midstream and vowing to launch the Northern Expeditions. The path seems self-evident: first, drive the Five Hu from the Central Plains; then, sweep away the great Aristocratic Clans entrenched in the royal court. Only then can one truly cleanse the realm, found a new order, and extend the legacy of Huaxia (Chinese civilization).
At least, that is how it should unfold in theory.
But when a modern soul awakens in the autumn of the fifth year of the Yonghe reign—specifically, in 349 CE—as nothing more than an ordinary refugee of the Eastern Jin, lofty ambitions must be set aside. The immediate concerns are brutally simple: how to survive the coming winter, and how to stay above the invisible line that decides who is worth keeping alive—and who falls beneath the execution threshold.
Thus it begins: not with heroism and grand banners, but as yet another seemingly clichéd transmigration story…
Only this time, cleansing and expansion will start from the very bottom.

192920.synopsis:
Many people were waiting to see Liao Qingyan make a fool of herself.
Everyone knew her family had gone bankrupt years ago, that she no longer belonged to this social circle. The only reason she stubbornly refused to leave, people assumed, was because she had once been Zhou Jin’s first love back in high school. She was trying to gamble on their old connection and pull off a carp-leaping-the-dragon-gate miracle. But the Zhou family’s threshold was not something an ordinary person could ever cross.
At one gathering, Zhou Jin was planning to propose. And the intended was naturally not Liao Qingyan.
A torrential rain poured down from nowhere. Rides were impossible to find. And her dress got stained.
Liao Qingyan waited in a pavilion for the rain to stop. A car pulled up. In the back seat sat Bo Sinian. The true center of their circle.
Perhaps seeing how miserable and bedraggled she looked, Bo Sinian politely asked if she needed help.
Liao Qingyan laughed. “If you really want to help, how about sleeping with me?”
